_what: Focused study of rule P-026 (compression box breakout): entry versions x exit (stop/target) versions, on EXPLORATION only, with a random-entry control per exit. Owner 2026-11-18: 'pegasse essa P26... gere versoes melhores, de outros sentidos, teste take profit, stop loss para ela... mais valido do que gerar muitas estrategias e uma que funciona'. Registered before any read; every version read is counted.
_entry: Box = the bars of the last box_min minutes of TODAY before bar t; H/L its high/low; R = (H-L)/close(t-1); N = median of R at the same minute over the 20 previous sessions. Compressed: R <= ratio_max x N. Event: close(t) >= H + 1 tick (up break) or <= L - 1 tick (down break). follow = trade the break's direction (the original P-026); fade = the opposite. Entry window: at least box_min minutes into the session and >= 75 minutes to the close. At most 4 entries per session, one position at a time. Original P-026 = tf 5, box 60, ratio 0.8, follow, exit X0.

X0.what: original: stop at the box midpoint (distance clamped to 0.10-0.30% of the price), no target, 60 min

X1.what: conveyor default: stop BRL 30, target BRL 30, 30 min

BT.what: stop 1 B, to breakeven at +1 B, then trailing 1 B, no target, 60 min

S1.what: stop 1 V, target 1 V (V = mean absolute 30-minute move at that minute over 20 sessions)

S2.what: high hit rate: stop 1.5 V, target 0.75 V

S4.what: stop 1 V, breakeven at +1 V, trailing 1 V, no target

_fills: As the conveyor: signal at the close of bar t, market order at the open of the next 1-minute bar (+slippage); each minute: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, -slippage -stop extra), then the target (needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); breakeven/trailing move the stop at the END of a minute (used from the next minute); time exit at the open of the minute at entry + hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time. Distances rounded to the tick, away from the entry. Costs: the conveyor's 'measured' decides, 'measured_p90' reported.

random_control._how: each real entry is moved to a random other exploration session at the same minute of day with a random side; same exit, same one-position and per-session limits

selection.beats_random: mean net per trade > the random control's mean net (same exit)
selection.plateau: at least 2/3 of the neighbours positive: one step on one entry parameter (same exit) and the listed neighbouring exits (same entry)
selection.pick: among versions passing all of the above, the highest total net per year; that version goes to the Clear demo next to the original; validation is read once, for that version only, before any real-account decision by the owner
selection._250: lower than the conveyor's 500 trades/year: the owner (2026-11-18) puts profit of one rule above frequency
